# Sendspark

Sendspark is a video messaging platform that empowers businesses to create, send, and track personalized video content, simplifying communication by allowing users to quickly record or upload videos and share them via email, social media, or other digital channels.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sendspark/.

## Actions

- **Add Multiple Prospects to Dynamic Campaign**: Add multiple prospects to a dynamic campaign in bulk.
- **Add Prospect to Dynamic Video Campaign**: Add a prospect to a dynamic video campaign.
- **Create Dynamic Video Campaign**: Create a dynamic video campaign.
- **Get Campaign Prospect Data By Email** (read-only): Retrieve prospect data by email within a dynamic campaign.
- **Get Dynamic Campaign by ID** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific dynamic video campaign.
- **Get Workspace Prospect Data by Email** (read-only): Retrieve prospect data by email in a dynamic campaign.
- **List Dynamic Video Campaigns** (read-only): List all dynamic video campaigns in a workspace.
- **API Health Status** (read-only): Check the health status of the sendspark api.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a specific webhook by its id.
- **List Webhooks** (read-only): List all configured webhooks.
